title: Haye Ashoor ke Din
body:
aaya kya daur e bala haye ashoor ke din
khul gaya baab e jafa haye ashoor ke din
<<DIVIDER>>
qatl zainab ke pisar kar diye jab aada ne
sar kiye tan se juda haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
<<DIVIDER>>
dulha qasim bin e farwa o hassan ka ran may
laasha pamaaal hua haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
<<DIVIDER>>
naujawan baap ki peeri ka sahara akbar
qatl naize se kiya haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
<<DIVIDER>>
quwwat e baazu e shabbir haram ki dhaaras
qatl darya pe hua haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki godh may cheh maah ke asghar ka ghazab
teer se halq chida haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab na baakhi rahe ansaar o aizza koi
qatl sarwar ko kiya haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar barehna kiya saydaniyo ko aada ne
cheen kar sar se rida haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
<<DIVIDER>>
jiske durr cheen ke zaalim ne tamache maare
uska daaman bhi jala haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham se phat jayenge seene jo likha tu ne anees
nauha e aale aba haye ashoor ke din
aaya kya daur e bala...
author: Anees
